BiblicalUsage: There was war again with the Philistines. Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name here is Jair, father of Elhanan, spelled in the old writing as Jaur: the son who slew Goliath's brother carried his father's name into the battle, and the record keeps the father's spelling beside the son's deed.
